decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis still has its own page and runs on the firm's maintained market data, so its value is not yet resolved and keeping the option open stays cheap.
The gas tariff comparison is close to the core tariff offer and costs little to maintain on the shared databases, and nothing shows its value will fail to materialize.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a low-cost extension of the established tariff database, so the option remains worth holding even after the related line D was withdrawn.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products on the central platform, so it adds value to several options at little cost.

The site-specific comparison line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with B, which raises the risk of consolidation, but its upkeep is cheap and the uncertainty is not yet clearly resolved against it.
